latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — generate videos from scripts with cloud GPU processing.

- Turn TXT, DOCX, PDF, or pasted scripts into shareable videos (up to 500MB files).
- Automatic setup: free 7-day token, quick session creation, no install needed.
- Supports uploading, editing, previewing, and exporting 1080p MP4 videos in 1–2 minutes.
- Includes balance checking, real-time editing, and detailed error handling.
- Works for marketers, creators, and educators wanting fast, no-footage video generation.
